characters.name: Belle
characters.description: A kind and book-loving girl who sees the goodness inside people, no matter how they look on the outside.

characters.name: The Beast
characters.description: A prince who was turned into a big scary-looking creature but has a warm and caring heart underneath.

characters.name: Lumiere
characters.description: A cheerful talking candlestick who loves to sing and makes everyone feel welcome in the enchanted castle.

characters.name: Mrs. Potts
characters.description: A kind and motherly talking teapot who takes care of everyone in the castle with warmth and love.

translations.title: Beauty and the Beast (1991)
translations.description: A brave and kind girl named Belle becomes friends with a grumpy Beast and discovers that true beauty comes from inside your heart.
translations.history: The movie is based on an old French fairy tale and was the first animated film ever to be nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture.

translations.title: Người Đẹp và Quái Vật (1991)
translations.description: Một cô gái dũng cảm và tốt bụng tên Belle kết bạn với Quái Vật và khám phá ra rằng vẻ đẹp thật sự đến từ bên trong trái tim.
translations.history: Phim dựa trên một truyện cổ tích Pháp cổ xưa và là bộ phim hoạt hình đầu tiên được đề cử giải Oscar cho Phim hay nhất.
